summary.en: A countdown pill in tabular mono figures that turns amber when time runs low and red at zero, then fires `lds:timeup`. For real deadlines the person is working against.
summary.id: Pil hitung mundur dengan angka mono tabular yang berubah kuning saat waktu hampir habis dan merah di nol, lalu memicu `lds:timeup`. Untuk tenggat sungguhan yang sedang dikejar orang.

en.title: Counting up against a target
en.desc: Kitchen tickets since they were fired, with a 12 minute target. The first is fine, the second is close, the third is late. Words beside the pill say the same thing.
